items.passage: Transcript: Hi, orientation leaders, this is Leilani Brightwater from the orientation office with some changes for move-in week. In past years, you met your group of new students in the lobby of the residence hall where they were living. This year, groups are organized by academic program, so most of you will meet your group outside the building where that program is based. The international students are different. They arrive two days early for their own sessions in Room 109 of Dunmore Annex, and their groups will meet right there in that room, once the last of those sessions ends. Your assignment sheet lists the program, not the hall, so read it before Monday. One more thing. The leaders' briefing was going to be in the orientation office. That room only holds about forty people, and there are sixty of us this year, so we'll all be in Room 347 instead, Monday at ten.
items.prompt: [Announcement — Student orientation team] Where will the international students' groups meet?
choices: In Room 109 of Dunmore Annex, after their final early session
In the lobby of the residence hall where they are living
Outside the building where their academic program is based
In the orientation office, before their early sessions begin
items.correct_answer: In Room 109 of Dunmore Annex, after their final early session
items.explanation: The speaker says the international students have early sessions 'in Room 109 of Dunmore Annex, and their groups will meet right there in that room, once the last of those sessions ends.' 'In the lobby of the residence hall where they are living' is how groups met 'in past years'. 'Outside the building where their academic program is based' is this year's arrangement for most groups, but 'The international students are different.' 'In the orientation office, before their early sessions begin' attaches the office, where the leaders' briefing was originally planned, to the wrong thing, and the meeting is after the sessions, not before.

choices: To explain why the briefing moved
To explain why the briefing runs twice
To explain why leaders should come early
To explain why groups are capped at forty
items.correct_answer: To explain why the briefing moved
items.explanation: The line follows 'The leaders' briefing was going to be in the orientation office' and is followed by 'there are sixty of us this year, so we'll all be in Room 347 instead': the capacity is the reason for the change of room. 'To explain why the briefing runs twice' is wrong because the speaker says 'we'll all be in Room 347', one session. 'To explain why leaders should come early' is a reading the line alone allows, but the speaker solves the space problem by moving rooms and never mentions arriving early. 'To explain why groups are capped at forty' misattaches the number: forty is the old room's capacity, not a group size.
